evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of progressiveleg swelling and breathlessness concerning
for possible heart failure.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 55 bpm. Normalaxis. PR interval 176 ms, QRS 92 ms, QTc 446
ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normal tracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
50%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

Fasting lipid panel this admission: total cholesterol: 262 mg/dL, LDL: 176 mg/dL, HDL: 41
mg/dL, triglycerides: 229 mg/dL.

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 138 mmol/L
Potassium: 4.9 mmol/L
Chloride: 99 mmol/L
CO2: 26 mmol/L
BUN: 16 mg/dL
Creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL
Glucose: 80 mg/dL
Calcium: 10.2 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Furosemide 20 mg by mouth once daily
